note: Most garba songs are old folk and devotional songs with no single author, sung anew by each generation, so the same title turns up in many versions. Non-stop medley albums are how the music is mostly sold and played.

size.basis: Garba is a large commercial regional market: every Navratri brings new non-stop volumes (Ramzat from 2017, Rangtaali 2017 and 2019 with 36 tracks on volume 2, many more from Gujarati labels such as Sur Sagar and Red Ribbon), plus re-recordings of the same traditional songs by star singers (Atul Purohit, Falguni Pathak, Praful Dave, Hemant Chauhan, Kirtidan Gadhvi), and 1970s LPs (Polydor 1976, HMV 1978). No catalogue total was found; the range is a rough count of issued tracks including the many duplicate versions. The core is the few dozen traditional songs every Navratri set returns to.
